framing: Deterministic universal grammar candidate search control, not random noise and not a claimed learned feature repair

language.constant: Only const has value; every other operation has an args array
language.costs: Generic set/induced-edge/greedy/cover primitives incur their real full graph or repair active-set computation cost
language.feature_dependency: Feature expression trees cannot refer to other feature names
language.numeric: Counts/gaps are integer seconds/counts; contact weight/duration are exact Fraction seconds; aggregates use execution math.fsum
language.root: Only root() produces Node; available() is the current residual active NodeSet
language.rule_operators: + - * /; unary +/-; conditional if/else; comparisons; and/or/not; calls min/max/abs only
language.selection: Larger score wins; deterministic contact-id tie breaking is kernel-owned and not accessible to the rule
language.station_gap: Actual root contact antenna gap, not a global mean/minimum
language.unavailable_inputs: No identifiers, epoch, source, configuration tag, edge-mask accessor, or offline label/oracle operation

program.name: grammar_base_0
program.rationale: Universal deterministic MWIS grammar template; exact same public typed operations and scorer. Local or base cost and normalization alternative; no label-specific tuning.

provenance.selection: Candidate selection is performed later under the same TRAIN/VAL protocol; no solver run by generator
provenance.size_guard: 128 active vertices for broader residual templates; all scopes/costs use real currentavailable()
